description: Search the Washington, Delaware or California Attorney General breach-notice list by public notifying-organisation name and year (notice year for Washington and Delaware, reported year for California). Timing uses only the dates in each record: Washington and Delaware results label whether the interval is beyond that state's statutory window by the record's dates. The records do not show permitted delays, including law-enforcement requests, or any enforcement outcome; the timing flag is no legal finding. Never call a notice "late" or say an organisation "violated" the law. California has no discovery date, so no timing is computed. Resident counts are notices sent to residents, not unique people, and are never added across states; Delaware also reports the company's stated total affected separately. A notifying organisation may differ from the breached one. Names that may identify individuals are withheld, never returned or searchable. Absence from these three lists is no evidence that an organisation had no breach.

beyond_window.description: WA or DE only: beyond the statutory window by the record dates; the records do not show permitted delays.

organization.description: Optional case-insensitive public organization name substring, at most 80 characters; withheld names are never searched.

state.description: Required Attorney General notice list: WA, DE or CA.

year.description: Optional year of the state record date: WA/DE notice date or CA reported date.

name: breach_notices
title: Find State Breach Notices
